risk_summary.quantity_basis: gross held positions; pending orders not netted

positions.thesis: RoboStrategy is a closed-end private-robotics access position. Monthly NAV growth and portfolio-company financing or liquidity events must outrun the stock's premium to Level 3 marks, a 2.50% management fee on gross assets, dilution, and weak price discovery.
A development-stage bet on Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus. Commercial agreements and funded delivery—not headline capacity—must validate it.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is an AI infrastructure and networking mix-shift position. Juniper integration, data-center networking, and server demand must convert into durable margins and free cash flow rather than acquisition-inflated growth or backlog headlines.

RTX is a commercial-aerospace and defense backlog-conversion position. Collins, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon must turn a $289 billion backlog into durable organic growth and free cash flow while supply-chain disruption, fixed-price execution, and the GTF powder-metal fleet plan stay controlled.

Planet's daily Earth-imagery archive can compound into a recurring geospatial-data platform as defense, intelligence, and sovereign demand grows; Pelican execution and backlog conversion must outrun launch risk, capital intensity, and dilution.
Financial-sector leadership plus Robinhood growth and a rising blockchain-fee thesis.

SpaceX is a vertically integrated launch, connectivity, and AI-infrastructure position. Starship progress, Starlink scale, and contracted AI compute must convert exceptional growth into durable cash economics while capital intensity, execution, regulation, acquisition risk, and governance stay controlled.

Kopin is a speculative defense-optics and microdisplay position. Government-funded MicroLED development, defense programs, and prototype wins must convert into product revenue and sustainable profitability before litigation, concentration, cash needs, or execution consume the upside.

NVIDIA is an AI-compute platform position. Vera Rubin production and accelerating inference demand must convert a $108 billion Q3 revenue outlook into durable growth and cash generation while supply commitments, China restrictions, customer concentration, and elevated expectations stay controlled.

Ethereum adoption thesis: Robinhood Chain is an Ethereum L2 aimed at tokenized real-world assets, while a crypto-friendly U.S. policy backdrop and depressed Web3 valuations create rerating optionality; BMNR must grow ETH per share faster than dilution and operating drag.

Figure is a capital-light consumer-credit marketplace position. Loan volume, Figure Connect adoption, and partner growth must translate into durable adjusted revenue and earnings without credit deterioration, warehouse-funding stress, or mark-to-market noise masking economics.

Hims & Hers is a subscription-health platform and international expansion position. Subscriber growth and personalized care must sustain domestic reacceleration and profitable scale while regulatory, pharmacy, acquisition-integration, and product-mix risks remain controlled.
